message.subject: Re: Motor IE3 4 kW: framework renewal
message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Your quote is on our desk, and we have set it up so that it can go through your pricing committee in one step: three clear options, one package we can approve.

On quality:
Your quality was 764 ppm defective parts in the four quarters to 2026Q3 (sc:70520@2026Q3).

On volume:
Our forecast for Motor IE3 4 kW, 4-pole rises 7.6% (fc:350010@2026-09).

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 220.69; payment 90 days net; contract term 24 months; Incoterm DAP.
Option B: unit price EUR 219.39; payment 60 days net; contract term 24 months; Incoterm DAP.
Option C: unit price EUR 218.75; payment 45 days net; contract term 24 months; Incoterm DAP.

Option A is the package we can approve. Given the quality record and the rising forecast, it gives Vesmo a stable framework renewal with the longest payment term as the only difference, and it keeps the structure simple for your approvers.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away.

For your pricing committee, here is a paragraph that can be forwarded unchanged: Hollerau Pumpenwerke proposes a renewal of the framework for the IE3 4 kW motor on the terms of Option A, a clear contract term and a defined delivery basis, with a rising forecast for this motor.

Please take Option A to the approver. If your approval needs anything further from us, we will provide it promptly.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH
